name: Elisabeth Myslisch — marriage in February 1845, Oxhöft, West Prussia
researcher_question: When and where did Elisabeth Myslisch marry Anton Netzel, the parents of Elisabeth Netzel (christened 1845) and Valentin Netzel (christened 1847) at Oxhöft, West Prussia?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-3.csv row 11, hint-samples.csv row 407, flags adds_birth/adds_marriage, confidence 3). Resolved 2026-10-14 (#3334): true match, probable not proved. The 2 Feb 1845 Oxhöft marriage of Anton Netzel and Elisabeth Desmer (ark:/61903/1:1:6ZMF-97V3) is accepted as KV1W-XVF's on the index alone: the couple's 1845/1847/1850 Oxhöft baptisms name the mother Myslisch/Myslisz/Myslisck (Eva), and no other Netzel-Myslisch marriage is indexed. The register image is access-restricted (403) and was not read, so image_basis is off.
